summary: @arv-bedrock/auth-sso preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and per-function dictionary indirection) and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled 727KB single-line Bun-compiled CJS file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (shuffled string-array decoder function `WV8StW` rotating the `n7gIxM` array, hex-named identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) so its contents are executed on the installer's machine under a runtime distinct from Node. The package's advertised purpose is an SSO authentication client, which has no need for a separately downloaded alternate runtime or an obfuscated multi-hundred-kilobyte install-time payload. The loader-plus-opaque-payload structure and the use of Bun specifically to bypass Node-oriented inspection are the defining shape of an alternate-runtime install-time dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
